news.title: U.S. Rep. Julia Letlow, endorsed by Trump, wins the GOP primary for Senate in Louisiana
news.summary: Letlow, who was endorsed by Trump, defeated state Treasurer John Fleming in the two-candidate runoff after they finished ahead of Cassidy in the GOP primary May 16.
